title: French language with Alma
author: French language with Alma
description:
My name is Alma H. and I am a French teacher.  I have a master's degree in French language and literature and I have more than 10 years of teaching experience. 
This Youtube channel is educational and it will help you practice sentences, do dictations and learn vocabulary and verbs. This content will help you to improve your knowledge of the French language. 
Email for Individual online classes :
 french.with.alma@gmail.com

Cette chaîne Youtube est éducative et vous aidera à pratiquer des phras
